localDraftDescription: Saved in this browser. LifeOS never uploads this draft until you explicitly choose a workspace sync action.
workspaceSyncDescription: Checking, loading, and saving are explicit. Your local draft is never uploaded in the background.
workspaceMissingStatus: No durable Today exists for this date. Your local draft is still unchanged.
workspaceFoundStatus: A durable Today exists. Review your choice before replacing either copy.
workspaceSavedStatus: The current local Today is saved durably. Later local edits still require another explicit save.
workspaceLoadedStatus: The durable Today was explicitly loaded into this browser and is also stored locally.
workspaceConflictStatus: Another device changed Today. Check the workspace again before deciding which copy to keep.
workspaceSignInStatus: Sign in before checking or saving a durable Today.
workspaceUnavailableStatus: Workspace Today is temporarily unavailable. Your local draft remains unchanged.
replaceWorkspaceWithLocal: Replace workspace with this local draft
useWorkspaceToday: Use workspace Today in this browser
todayDescription: Capture what is pulling at your attention, commit to no more than three priorities, and give each one an honest place on the clock.
storageUnavailable: Browser storage is unavailable. This tab remains usable, but changes will not survive a reload.
storageSaveUnavailable: The local draft could not be saved. This tab remains usable, but changes may not survive a reload.
priorityLimitError: Three priorities are already committed. Release one first.
scheduleConflictError: That time overlaps another open priority.
changeFailedError: That change could not be applied safely.
captureEmptyError: Enter an action before adding it.
captureSuccess: Action captured locally. Commit it only when it belongs in today’s top three.
noPrioritiesDescription: Capture actions, then commit only the three that make today successful.
backlogEmpty: Nothing waiting. Capture ideas without promising them.
captureCounter: {count}/160 · Stored only in this browser until you explicitly sync it.
searchHelper: Authenticated workspace records; local drafts are excluded.
searchMinimum: Enter at least two characters to search the workspace.
searchSignIn: Sign in to search durable workspace records.
